paras: Anolis darlingtoni, also known commonly as Darlington's anole and the La Hotte twig anole, is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is endemic to Haiti.
The specific name, darlingtoni, is in honor of American entomologist Philip Jackson Darlington Jr.
A. darlingtoni is found in the Massif de la Hotte mountain range, Département du Sud, Haiti.
The preferred natural habitat of A. darlingtoni is forest, at elevations of 1,360–1,500 m (4,460–4,920 ft).
